title: Distance after two coordinate changes
statement: For every $n\ge 0$, every $x\in\mathbb F_2^n$, and every pair of coordinates $i,j$, the Hamming distance from $x$ to the vector obtained by adding $1$ at both coordinates is at most $2$.
